title: How insane judgments can be!
author: resignorcry
selftext:
It's not a week yet since I released my game in playstore and my expectations was kinda higher!! To get at least 100 download in the first week and maybe 1k in the first month! However I got less than 50 🥲 i tried marketing for it in many ways in ytb TikTok and Instagram.. some of my video was edited by Ai, I was satisfied by the results However many people wasn't!! And they start with \[lol, ai slop channel,.. \] that makes me feel so bad honestly why people are too sensitive when someone makes something and use tools that everyone use.. i can't understand this part as well ..

Here's my game: [my game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.soulgames.slidelock) but I don't really understand what's going on! 

Im not gonna stop anyways lol its part of my studies so not like i could do stop!

comments.author: YuukiCrypto
comments.body: You need playtesters. You cannot release a game without getting feedback from playtesters first. You will always think your game is good

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: yeah true.. i played it like 100 times myself so ofc it feels easy to me lol. gonna find some people to test it

comments.author: arcarsenal986
comments.body:
Honest criticism, I have no idea what the game is from your description in the store, nor from the screenshots. 

Looks like I just click to move my guy? I'm not downloading it to try, sorry, I don't play phone games.

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: fair enough lol. you swipe and the block slides until it hits a wall, goal is to reach the hole in the least moves. guess my screenshots don't really show that.. gonna fix it, thanks for being honest

comments.author: AaronMatthews25
comments.body:
Your game has "the look" to it, and the cool thing with AI is you can fix everything wrong, but you have to tell it to fix it.

Looking at your photos for the game I see fire effect not centered on the dots for the i's.

AI always wants to add witty one liners I need to remove. "Every spark remembers." what does that mean?

None of your text is centered in the buttons

Some buttons have 3d drop shadow while others dont

"The creatures from Solenne. Stars bring them back." Confusing and not relevant information in a character selection.

Some characters have a second line while some dont, inconsistent

Sparks page has inconsistent spacing the sparks are overlapping with eachother and look messy.

The game itself has buttons at the bottom could be better, looks like they were ai drawn vectors and got kind messed up. Big oval pause button at the top left that's weird.

Overall you should take "ai slop" as constructive criticism. People aren't stupid, they know what they're seeing. And it's your job to make it good

replies.author: Ok-Pirate5732
replies.body: Lol Claude loves to sneak in the word remembers in these dumb one liners for some reason

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: damn ok you actually looked at everything 😅 went back to check and yeah you're right, the pause button is literally an oval lol. didn't notice half of this stuff. gonna clean it up before adding anything else, thanks man

comments.author: thecrustycrap
comments.body: your screenshots need some work, i dont know which part is the puzzle, you should come up with screenshots at the front ,describing what is happening, or showcasing the gameplay

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: Yeah absolutely agree with you I just noticed that thanks for the feedback, sometimes we become blind because of getting excited "its my game look look" lol 😆

replies.author: thecrustycrap
replies.body:
Sure I actually understand your excitement lol, sometimes I get blindsided from what I’m working on too, so it’s good to have other people to take a look, you’re taking criticism well! Which is a plus, hope you make it.

I’d suggest try looking at popular games in the App Store, try to take inspiration from how they describe the gameplay with their screens, it should help a lil

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: Thank you so much ill definitely do that 🌟

comments.author: EconomySerious
comments.body: a bad game is  bad game, no mather who created it

comments.author: Desperate-Ad2131
comments.body: My honest feedback is: go watch a tutorial on YouTube about how to make a game! Those are all really helpful

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: So this is the problem everyone claims its made by ai like the whole project is one prompt 🙄 and people don't see time much time and effort it takes!! Again it's 2026 even our professors use ai to save time and become more productive! Yo thanks for nothing I don't really appreciate it

replies.author: Desperate-Ad2131
replies.body:
I think starting by not posting in AI groups would be an idea, especially if you claim that the majority of the game isnt made with AI.

The main reason why your game is not performing well, is due to the look of it. Is it your first game? If it is, see it more as a learning experience, rather than a successful commercial release

comments.author: DealerIcy3439
comments.body: If I ever get to the point of sharing my game, I just hope 10 people get it period

replies.author: resignorcry
replies.body: I hope you ull get that , truly believing in you ! However its kinda hard when look how much time efforts and money [ads for nothing hhh] is just for 40player but im still optimistic its just about the hate comments that makes me feel bad and wanna give up ..
